newsitem.title: USA: Pepsi Puerto Rico Q1 down due to low pricing.
newsitem.headline: Pepsi Puerto Rico Q1 down due to low pricing.

text.p: Pepsi-Cola Puerto Rico Bottling Co said Thursday that first quarter results were down primarily due to "intensive pricing pressure in the Puerto Rican soft drink market."

Contributing to the net loss in the first quarter, ending December 31, were extraordinary legal expenses associated with the company's civil lawsuits which were $1.1 million higher than the preceeding first quarter.
Competitive activity during the quarter resulted in net prices 14 percent lower than during the first quarter of the preceeding fiscal year, the company said.
Because of continued strong competitive activity, the company said it is not clear whether current prices will be maintained.

The company said its labor unions agreed to forego wage increases scheduled to take effect January 1, 1997. And labor agreed to other contract modifications, which should reduce costs, the company said.
Negotiations with the company's health service providers are expected to cut health service expenses by about one-third, begining March 1, the company said.
